claims.quote: Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.
A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your regional logistics team is facing challenges with approval delays, and we are here to help. As requested, we would be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your workflow coordination and account reporting needs. This will allow us to establish the integration requirements and tailor our solution to your specific requirements.

Please let us know a convenient time for the meeting, and we will make the necessary arrangements.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders that should be included in the meeting?
